ms.promise:
Objective:
Set new programming environment in new hardware, setup the new cloud environment for the site hosting. Deliver a report on the strategy for the Economic incentive that users have to read.

Outputs:
1- We will deliver our first report which will include our new whitepaper and new goals for the project.

2- Marcial will deliver a list of smart contracts that have been made and a report on what is missing to have the functional side of the contracts running for milestone 3

3- This milestone will include a submitted review of our new programming environment with new equipment. Send a list of reviewed material from the pioneer’s program with a list of contracts that we will be using. This will be included in the report.

5- We will send an update with a Gantt Chart showing the progress of the project and the deliverables for project management purposes. A presentation with new features and new tech stack will be presented.
ms.criteria: Monthly reports discussing the topics mentioned in the outputs will be presented along with the files of the gantt chart and resources. All of this will be sent to our site.
ms.report:
We have a Gantt chart showing steps that have been made. 

We have two Github lists that have tons of open source smart contracts and other resources for developing on Cardano. 

We have a report on what kind of smart contracts we have found and how much of their utility will we be able to leverage.

I have set up my new coding environment according to an article I saw that allows for coding in Containers on VScode.

We have partnered with Matrix.io, and will be leveraging the infrastructure that they have built out on their website. This is a quantum leap in the advancement of building out a functional MVP.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DEGZejvL1iU4jRb5RmQTcfLkC2s50nTd1L5kfPmzecI/edit

ms.promise:
Objective:
To deliver a site for direct communication with the team, a blog for review and further submissions to the community. Develop the first smart contract for the testnet and submit the file.

Outputs:
1- A file with the first contract running on the online smart contract compiler will be presented.

2- The wireframe of the website, the figma file, the paths and menus will be presented. The file will be posted on our blog site and sent with the Catalyst report.

3- A video of the site’s design and details will be presented so that people can see what features and in which order they will be created. The APIs that will be used will also be listed in the wireframe video and file.

4- We will be sending our research report of the APis that will be used along with our updated whitepaper for the project.
ms.criteria: Monthly reports will be presented along with the files. All of this will be sent to our site.
ms.report:
Website was changed to https://realtoro.org/

Demonstration of functionality done using Preview Testnet and Dev site. We have pushed updates to the main production site now as well.
 
 The smart contract we use as our base is generalizable to fractionalization of assets as well.

Videos show ability to:
1. receive a DiD using Stripe KYC API
2. Ability for users to tokenize their properties
3. Ability for users to list their properties for lease
a. With the choice of making the seller or the buyer pay the fees during the lease contract with a slider.
4. Ability to add images and descriptions to their properties
5. Ability to explore properties listed on the site
6. Ability to accept a lease contract on the site as the buyer
7. Ability to make an offer on a lease contract as a buyer
8. Ability to accept an offer as a seller/property owner (in works to make this process smoother)
9. Ability to make payments on the smart contract that represents the lease.
10. Ability to receive a Token at the end of the Smart contract term, this token represents completion of the full lease

Enhancements we would like to continue to work on:
1. Make the UI smoother
2. Iron out some kinks with the site
3. Get a proper audit of the smart contract
4. Build Trust and review ratings into the site

We would love to review this project over a call so please feel free to reach out to us.

ms.promise:
Objective:
To deliver the contract and a basic working site where you can submit a listing for review and tokenization.

Outputs:
1- We will publish the form generator that will give the smart contracts the necessary information to make documentation necessary to start the smart contract.

2- We will publish the site with the basic document generator. The site will allow users to submit listings, after review, each listing will be tokenized as an NFT and users may play with the NFTs in our marketplace.

3- A report over the functional section of the listing process will be submitted and a video with the explanation will be shared with the community,
ms.criteria:
Users can copy and paste the contract and test it on the Cardano contract playground
Users can submit a listing form and payment for us to check and list a rent NFT on their wallet.

ms.promise: An MVP where Users can post houses for rent, bid on houses for rent, and use smart contracts to automate payment processing of rent, receive NFT receipts, and be able to register to our site and in turn receive an NFT that verifies them as being legitimate people partaking in the marketplace.A video showing how someone can sign up, go through the verification process and receive their identity token. Then show how a user can list a house for rent, and how another user can then bid on that house. and How payment through the platform will produce NFT receipts for every month's payment.

Users can submit a proposal feature on the forms.
Users can browse the blog for updates.
Users can test our verification process for transactions of the assets that represent rent.
